method: Unchanged original classes, after Block/Item registration, run with a constructor-less player/world double that records dropped and broken stacks. Utility libraries: guava-20.0.jar, log4j-api-2.14.1.jar, commons-lang3-3.12.0.jar. Item IDs are Minecraft IDs.

# Inventory scripts shared by InventoryProbe.java and tools/inventory-replay.mjs.
# Item IDs are Minecraft 1.7.10 numeric IDs. `inv` uses InventoryPlayer
# indices (0-8 hotbar, 9-35 main); `put` and `click` use container slot numbers.
# ContainerPlayer: 0 result, 1-4 grid, 5-8 armor, 9-35 main, 36-44 hotbar.
# ContainerWorkbench: 0 result, 1-9 grid, 10-36 main, 37-45 hotbar.
# ContainerFurnace: 0 input, 1 fuel, 2 output, 3-29 main, 30-38 hotbar.
# ContainerChest: 0-26 chest, 27-53 main, 54-62 hotbar; with a large chest
# 0-53 chest (first chest 0-26), 54-80 main, 81-89 hotbar.
# click SLOT BUTTON MODE uses Container.slotClick modes 0-6.
